raw.details:
Srujana Hackathon  Batch 2

About the Hackathon

Srujana Hackathon Series 2026 – Batch 2 is an innovation-driven initiative designed to bring together students, aspiring developers, and creative problem-solvers to explore real-world challenges and develop impactful solutions.

Organized at Biorad Medisys, Prabhavee Tech Park, Pune, the event will introduce participants to the Srujana initiative, provide insights into Ethosh’s projects and Biorad’s AI initiatives, and present problem statements that encourage innovative thinking and practical problem-solving.

Participants will gain an understanding of the challenges, proposed solution expectations, and judging criteria before beginning their ideation and development journey. The event offers an opportunity to learn, collaborate, think creatively, and explore how technology can address real-world problems.

Whether you are passionate about software development, Artificial Intelligence, or innovation, Srujana is an opportunity to turn your ideas into meaningful solutions.

Event Details

Date: 31 October 2026
Venue: Prabhavee Tech Park, Pune, Maharashtra https://maps.app.goo.gl/StYkMPJUhUxGEvuB8
Registration Time: 9:00 AM – 9:30 AM
Session Begins: 9:30 AM sharp

Event Schedule

  • 9:00 AM – 9:30 AM: Participant Registration
  • 9:30 AM onwards: Introduction to Srujana
  • Overview of Ethosh’s Projects and Bio-Rad’s AI Initiatives
  • Introduction to Hackathon Problem Statements
  • Explanation of Problem Statements and Judging Rubrics
  • Ideation and Solution Development

Further details regarding subsequent sessions and solution presentations will be communicated to participants by the organizing team.

What to Expect

  • Insights into real-world industry challenges and AI initiatives.
  • An introduction to problem statements and evaluation criteria.
  • Opportunities to brainstorm, ideate, and develop innovative solutions.
  • A collaborative environment that encourages creativity and technical thinking.
  • Exposure to industry-oriented problem-solving approaches.

Important Instructions

  • Participants must arrive at the venue by 9:00 AM to complete registration.
  • Carry a valid Aadhaar Card and College ID Card for verification.
  • Bringing a laptop is optional, but participants may carry one if they wish.
  • Please arrive on time and follow the instructions provided by the organizing team.
